# REQ-PV-015 — Strengthen the documentation-first positioning with diagrams, reverse lookup, PR diff, and health metrics

- **Type:** requirement
- **Domain:** PV
- **Tags:** `pv`, `improvement`, `documentation`, `ux`
- **Created:** 2026-05-03T00:00:00.000Z

## Description

After repositioning PV around the documentation value (rather than token efficiency alone), the missing pieces that make a real architecture-docs tool become the priorities: visual diagrams (Mermaid/Graphviz) for human consumption, file → node reverse lookup for code review, graph-aware PR diff with breaking-change detection, and graph quality metrics so users can tell if their graph is healthy. Together these turn PV from a CLI for agents into a documentation tool that humans will keep using even without an AI agent.
